clue.text: Biased message getting jolly good inspection, as some might say

indicators.note: flags that the phrase is to be pronounced in a particular accent, giving the answer's sound

parts.note: proper is slang for jolly good or thorough, and a gander is a look or inspection

explanation.surface: A one-sided message gets a thorough going-over from critics.
explanation.walkthrough: Said in a non-rhotic accent, PROPER GANDER, 'proper' meaning jolly good and 'gander' a look, comes out as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Propaganda is information slanted to promote a cause, hence a biased message.

clue.text: Very loud repetitive work coming up? Escape!

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: FF is fortissimo, the musical marking for very loud
OP, short for opus, a musical work, repeated

explanation.surface: Faced with deafening, monotonous labour ahead, someone urges a getaway.
explanation.walkthrough: FF plus OPOP, read upwards because 'coming up', gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To pop off is an informal phrase for leaving quickly, so it serves as an exclamation urging escape.

clue.text: Men sang out — we may have heard them rendering hymns

definitions.text: we may have heard them rendering hymns

parts.note: OR stands for other ranks, enlisted men in the army

indicators.note: out signals the letters of sang are put out of order

explanation.surface: A choir of men sang, and we heard the hymns ringing out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Men' is not anagram fodder: it is OR, other ranks; only SANG is rearranged, by 'out', to GANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Church organs are the instruments that accompany congregations singing hymns.

clue.text: Sell water in a novel water container

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone proposes selling water inside an innovative kind of tank.
explanation.definitionFit: An artesian well is a bore into an aquifer under pressure, a source that holds and supplies water.

clue.text: Area / where religions clashed

definitions.meaning: ..., a port in present-day Israel, was fought over by Crusaders and Muslim armies

explanation.walkthrough: Acre was besieged during the Crusades, Christians against Muslims.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a measure of land and the historic Levantine port city contested in the Crusades.

clue.text: Poor conductor to fail with terrible recital, no ace with music ultimately

parts.note: to die can mean to fail or stop working, as an engine dies

indicators.note: terrible signals the remaining letters are mangled into a new order
no tells us the ace is to be dropped from the word recital

parts.note: A is the usual card abbreviation for ace

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word music

explanation.surface: A conductor flops after a dreadful recital, lacking star quality and musical finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no ace' removes A from RECITAL; 'terrible' scrambles RECITL into LECTRI. 'Conductor' looks musical but is electrical.
explanation.definitionFit: A dielectric is an insulating material, one that carries electric current very badly.

clue.text: First to be bumped off in sinful situation

definitions.text: First to be bumped off in sinful situation

indicators.note: bumped off tells us a letter is knocked away from the word for the situation

parts.note: Babel, whose tower was built in pride, stands for a sinful state of confusion

indicators.note: first to points to the opening letter of the word be

explanation.surface: The first murder victim met his end amid sin.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove B, the first letter of 'be', from BABEL. As a whole, the clue describes Abel, the first man killed, by his brother Cain.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis Abel is murdered by Cain, making him the first person ever killed.

clue.text: Shrub African Muslim established on island

parts.note: the Berbers are a mainly Muslim people of North Africa

explanation.surface: A North African settles on an island beside a bush.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' places BERBER above IS; 'established' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Berberis, or barberry, is a genus of thorny garden bushes.

clue.text: Two at the top of height confused — allowance must be made

indicators.note: two at the top of picks out the first pair of letters in the word for height
confused means those two letters are mixed up, changing their order

parts.note: altitude is height above sea level

explanation.surface: Muddled about two heights at the summit, someone says leeway must be given.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the first two letters of ALTITUDE gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Latitude means freedom of action, the leeway or allowance granted to someone.

clue.text: Book / someone who could help grand player?

definitions.text: someone who could help grand player?
definitions.meaning: a pianist at a grand piano may have an assistant who turns the pages of the score

explanation.walkthrough: 'Grand' is a grand piano, not a fine performer.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both an unputdownable novel and the person turning sheet music for a pianist.

clue.text: British beast — one in a pack?

parts.note: a rat is a beast, an unpleasant animal

explanation.surface: A British animal that lives as one of a group.
explanation.walkthrough: The Brat Pack was a group of young 1980s Hollywood actors.
explanation.definitionFit: A brat is an unruly child, and a member of the Brat Pack is one such brat in a pack.

clue.text: Breeding technique in half the country?

parts.note: semi- is a prefix meaning half
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A method of animal breeding practised across half the land.
explanation.definitionFit: Insemination, often artificial, is a method used in breeding livestock.

clue.text: Like Sibelius, but with only half the notes perfect?

indicators.note: but with only says the word is cut down, with one part taken away

parts.note: Jean Sibelius was a composer from Finland, so Finnish
N is the abbreviation for note; of the pair of notes in the word, half is one

explanation.surface: A musician aspires to sound like Sibelius with half the notes.
explanation.walkthrough: N stands for note; FINNISH has two, and dropping one leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To finish something can mean to perfect it, giving it a final polish.

clue.text: Mess in settee least likely to be noticed?

indicators.note: mess is used as a verb, meaning jumble up the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Clutter in a sofa that nobody will spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The smallest thing is the one least likely to be seen, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Send home agent at speed — one in hiding

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative, an agent

indicators.note: in hiding says the letter for one is concealed within the following letters

parts.note: rate means speed, as in a rate of knots
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An undercover agent is sent home swiftly.
explanation.definitionFit: To repatriate someone is to return them to their own country.

clue.text: The age of sages? A waiting time maybe

definitions.meaning: cryptically, an age is the period that lies latent, concealed, in the word sages
a stretch of time before something shows itself, as between infection and symptoms

explanation.surface: The era of the wise men may be just a matter of waiting.
explanation.walkthrough: AGE is hidden in sAGEs: a period that is latent there.
explanation.definitionFit: A latent period is the interval between infection or stimulus and visible response, a stretch of waiting.

clue.text: Hilarious person wasting time given cheer in river

indicators.note: wasting means losing, so the letter for time is dropped

parts.note: a riot is someone very funny
bravo is a cheer of approval

explanation.surface: A comedian loses track of time and is cheered while in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rio Bravo is the Mexican name for the Rio Grande, the river on the US border.

clue.text: Ex-PM's dodgy deal is dire at heart

indicators.note: dodgy means unsound, so the letters are rearranged
at heart takes the central letters of the word dire

explanation.surface: A former Prime Minister's shady deal is dreadful at its core.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dodgy' looks like a comment on the deal but signals the rearrangement; 'at heart' takes only the middle of 'dire'.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Disraeli was Britain's Conservative Prime Minister in 1868 and 1874-80.

clue.text: Account given for reduced Information Technology? The situation can't be improved!

definitions.text: Account given for reduced Information Technology?
definitions.meaning: read literally, IT is what IT is: the abbreviated form of Information Technology is just IT
a resigned catchphrase accepting things as they are

explanation.walkthrough: 'Reduced' means abbreviated: Information Technology cut down is IT, and the phrase defines it.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a modern idiom of resignation, said when nothing can change a state of affairs.

clue.text: Old coins with slanted marks

definitions.meaning: ... were gold coins of the late Roman Empire
a solidus is the oblique stroke, or slash, used in writing

explanation.definitionFit: The plural of solidus names both Roman gold pieces and the diagonal punctuation strokes.

clue.text: Union officer separating from fellow at work

indicators.note: separating from tells us one piece is removed from the other

parts.note: a colleague is a fellow worker
Col is the abbreviation for colonel, an army officer

explanation.surface: A union official breaks away from a workmate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Union officer' looks like a trade union figure, but 'Union' is the definition and 'officer' the colonel.
explanation.definitionFit: A league is an alliance or association, a union of members.

clue.text: Difficulty about bright criminal's activity

indicators.note: about signals the word for difficulty is turned round

parts.note: rub means a difficulty, as in 'there's the rub'
glary means dazzlingly bright

explanation.surface: A clever criminal finds himself in a tight spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Burglary, breaking in to steal, is a typical criminal pursuit.

clue.text: Overcoat dad folded over in shelter

indicators.note: in tells us the reversed father goes inside the word for shelter

parts.note: a cote is a shelter for birds or animals, like a dovecote

indicators.note: folded over means the word for dad is turned back on itself

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: Dad folds his overcoat over him while sheltering.
explanation.definitionFit: A capote is a long hooded cloak or greatcoat.

clue.text: Ray's not finishing game

indicators.note: not finishing means the last letter is left off

parts.note: the skate is a type of ray, a flat fish

explanation.surface: Ray hasn't completed the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray' looks like a person's name but is the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Skat is a three-player trick-taking card game popular in Germany.

clue.text: Jump and cut loose initially

parts.note: to axe is to cut

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the word loose

explanation.surface: A command to leap and break free at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: An axel is a figure-skating leap with a forward take-off.

clue.text: Second female I call may be making a lot of noise

parts.note: to second a proposal is to back it
to ring is to call on the telephone

explanation.surface: A second woman I phone may be loud.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine backfiring produces loud bangs from mistimed combustion, so it is noisy.

clue.text: God of old to make discordant noise

parts.note: to din is to make a loud, jarring racket

explanation.surface: An ancient deity is said to create clamour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'God of old' reads as the definition, but 'old' supplies O; 'of' joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Odin is the chief of the Norse gods.

clue.text: Mechanical device consumed distilled liquid — the guy admits that

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: he refers to a man, the guy
eaten means consumed
gin is a distilled spirit

explanation.surface: A man confesses he ate the machine and drank the gin.
explanation.definitionFit: A heat engine converts thermal energy into mechanical work, like a steam engine.
